items.name: color-system
items.title: Color System
items.description: Color scales, semantic tokens, and utilities. Install without components.

items.name: foundation
items.title: Foundation
items.description: Kit CSS entry, component styles, hooks, and cn. Depends on color-system. Install first for components.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: Indeterminate circular loading indicator.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: Placeholder surface for loading text, blocks, and circles.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: Linear progress bar for determinate or indeterminate completion.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Button with variants, text and icon sizes, and a plain icon-only style.

items.name: status-dot
items.title: Status Dot
items.description: Filled status mark for online, live, and similar presence chips.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: Keyboard hint chip for shortcuts and key chords in menus and lists.

items.name: featured-icon
items.title: Featured Icon
items.description: Static featured icon shell with chrome variants, semantic colors, sizes, and a plain glyph mode.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: Field and section label with leading and trailing slots, required and optional marks, subtext, control inset alignment, and typography chrome. Use as label for form controls and as div for section titles.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: Binary on and off control for immediate settings.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: Single or dual thumb scrubber with marks, orientation, label, and value chrome. Prefer Number Slider for a compact settings row, and Tick Slider for bound labels with a tick gauge.

items.name: tick-slider
items.title: Tick Slider
items.description: Pill shell with bound labels, tick gauge, and a floating value bubble.

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Toggle Group
items.description: Grouped single- or multi-select toggles. Prefer Content Switcher for exclusive view modes as segments.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: Anchored floating panel for short content. Prefer Options Panel when the surface needs inputs, buttons, or other composed controls.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown Menu
items.description: Anchored action menu with header, body, and footer for profile menus, three dot menus, and toolbar actions. Body owns role menu. Rows compose List Item. Prefer Option List for pickers that keep a selected value.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: Compact pill and detailed rounded-square labels on hover and focus.

items.name: list-item
items.title: List Item
items.description: Presentational row with leading, secondary, trailing, density, and muted or accent variants. Includes ListItemLabel and ListItemNest. Option List, Select, Combobox, Tag Input, Contents Nav, and Dropdown Menu compose this for selectable options, outlines, and action menus.

items.name: contents-nav
items.title: Contents Nav
items.description: Page outline and catalogue index composed with List Item. Use toc for on-page headings with optional nest line and scroll spy. Use index for sectioned side navigation.

items.name: option-list
items.title: Option List
items.description: Open panel and option rows for pickers. Select composes this list.

items.name: options-panel
items.title: Options Panel
items.description: Anchored popover shell with header, body, and footer slots for custom controls. Footer owns gapX and gapY, with FooterActions and FooterMeta for paired actions and status copy. Prefer this over Popover when the surface needs composed controls.

items.name: dock-panel
items.title: Dock Panel
items.description: Collapsible edge-docked inspector with a kit scrollbar body. Prefer this for persistent side chrome; prefer Options Panel for anchored temporary controls.

items.name: nav-rail
items.title: Tool Rail
items.description: Fixed icon-over-label tool rail with composable items, separators, and tokenized chrome props. Does not expand into an inspector.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: Composable primary navigation with provider state, height modes, docked floating or inset variants, icon or offcanvas collapse, collapsible groups with chevron toggles, List Item menu rows, kit ScrollArea content, and a menu hierarchy. Prefer Tool Rail for icon mode switching and Dock Panel for inspectors.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Expandable sections with single or multiple open items, dividers, sizes, and keyboard navigation.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Tablist with pill, line, and segment variants for switching panels and modes.

items.name: content-switcher
items.title: Content Switcher
items.description: Segmented single-select control for filtering and view modes.

items.name: floating-controls
items.title: Floating Controls
items.description: Modular action bar with configurable slots and dividers for tool chrome.

items.name: format-toolbar
items.title: Format Toolbar
items.description: Rich text formatting toolbar with headings, marks, lists, callouts, and table row and column actions. Host owns document state through a controller.

items.name: overlay-hint
items.title: Overlay Hint
items.description: Tokenized instruction pill with frosted glass, muted chip, and marquee variants. Supports sm and md density plus configurable radius, chrome, and separator.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: Center modal with scrim, focus trap, Escape to close, and body scroll lock.

items.name: spectrum-text
items.title: Spectrum Text
items.description: Inline text with a shifting multi-stop SVG gradient fill. Glyphs stay still; only the clipped background moves. Configurable colors and speed.

items.name: border-glow
items.title: Border Glow
items.description: Card chrome with a pointer-directed border, optional soft bloom, and a hairline trace mode.

items.name: text-mark
items.title: Text Mark
items.description: Animated hand-drawn marks for inline text: marker wash, hand-drawn underline, or hand-drawn circle. Configurable shape, color, iterations, padding, and active state.

items.name: timeline
items.title: Timeline
items.description: Virtualized timeline with shared row scroll, time-scale bars, dependency routing, and snapped drag edits.

items.name: chart
items.title: Chart
items.description: Shared chart chrome: sized frame with empty and loading states, token tooltip surface, and legend. Compose plot primitives inside the frame.

items.name: widget-grid
items.title: Widget Grid
items.description: Twelve-column dashboard layout with drag move, edge resize, ghost previews, and keyboard cell editing.

items.name: editor
items.title: Editor
items.description: Markdown-first rich text surface with AST transforms, static and floating toolbars, and contentEditable input mapping.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: Person mark with photo or initials, optional presence, and a stacked overflow group.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: Native checkbox with optional label and description, including indeterminate.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: Filterable text field with an option list, optional async loading, and custom values.

items.name: command-palette
items.title: Command Palette
items.description: Searchable command dialog with ranking, optional async source, and recent ids.

items.name: context-menu
items.title: Context Menu
items.description: Pointer and keyboard menu with nested submenus and an imperative open helper.

items.name: data-grid
items.title: Data Grid
items.description: Virtualized table with resizable columns, selection, and optional cell editing.

items.name: date-picker
items.title: Date Picker
items.description: Single day and range calendars in a popover, with locale-aware month titles and week start.

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: Edge modal sheet with scrim, focus trap, and Escape to close.

items.name: empty-state
items.title: Empty State
items.description: Placeholder for missing or filtered results with glyph, title, description, and optional action.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio Group
items.description: Exclusive native radio group with optional heading and per-item labels.

items.name: split
items.title: Split
items.description: Two-pane layout with a keyboard and pointer resizable separator.

items.name: tag-input
items.title: Tag Input
items.description: Chip field for a string[] value with suggestions, paste batching, and max tags.
